description: In a world invaded by monsters, humanity awakens to supernatural powers. A famous fitness YouTuber with millions of views is transported into the world of a webtoon, only to discover that he has no supernatural ability at all and is treated as a powerless nobody. Instead of relying on special powers, he uses his extraordinary physical strength, fitness knowledge, and the power of the Stronger Gym to face the monsters and help save the world.
author: John Stone
